name: Duck Dodgers
description: Duck Dodgers battles evil in the 24th century.

videos.title: Duck Deception
videos.overview: Dodgers accidentally explodes the ship's energy core, sending the crew adrift.

videos.title: The Spy Who Didn't Love Me
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers must escort a beautiful secret agent to a Martian-controlled planet.

videos.title: The Fowl Friend
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers receives a robot crewmember, Roboto, but becomes jealous of the robot's perfect skills.

videos.title: The Fast and the Feathery
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers and Marvin compete in an interstellar race.

videos.title: The Trial of Duck Dodgers
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers and Cadet are put on trial for destroying Earth's defensive shield.

videos.title: Big Bug Mamas
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers responds to a planet's distress signal and mistakes its gelatinous inhabitants for the enemy invaders.

videos.title: Duck Codgers
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers and Cadet come into contact with a flower that induces rapid aging.

videos.title: Where's Baby Smartypants?
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers and Cadet must retrieve a baby philosopher to save a peace conference.

videos.title: I'm Going to Get You, Fat Sucka
videos.overview: A fat-sucking space vampire hypnotizes Duck Dodgers into detaining Cadet for a pork dinner.

videos.title: Detained Duck
videos.overview: Drake Darkstar, an evil Duck Dodgers doppelganger, steals Dodgers' identity to escape incarceration.

videos.title: K-9 Kaddy
videos.overview: A rebel army of gophers vows to overtake Mars.

videos.title: Pig of Action
videos.overview: Duck Dodgers and Cadet investigate space barbarians planning to invade Earth.

videos.title: Shiver Me Dodgers
videos.overview: Space pirates use a "disappearo" device to render their ship invisible. After they wreak havoc on luxury cruise liner, Duck Dodgers and Cadet disguise themselves as pirates to claim the "disappearo" device for Earth before the Commander claims it for Mars.

videos.title: They Stole Dodgers' Brain
videos.overview: Marvin kidnaps Dodgers and steals his brain, replacing it with a high tech gizmo that everyone mistakes for a fancy hat.

videos.title: The Wrath of Canasta
videos.overview: Dodgers drags Cadet along to Robo-World, a space vacation fantasy theme park where "Ya can't beat fightin' a bunch of defenseless androids!"

videos.title: The Green Loontern
videos.overview: Due to a mistake at the dry cleaners, Dodgers gets a Green Lantern uniform instead of his own. Donning the garment, mask and ring, Dodgers gains full Green Lantern powers.

videos.title: Quarterback Quack
videos.overview: Obsessed with ruining Dodgers' career, Marvin goes back in time to foil the college football exploits of his nemesis only to learn Dodgers must be schooled in his own field of alleged expertise.

videos.title: To Love a Duck
videos.overview: The Queen of Mars decides to take Dodgers as her King, if he can pass three Martian trials.

videos.title: Hooray for Hollywood Planet
videos.overview: New Hollywood mogul Harry Vermin lures Dodgers into a trap by offering to produce the duck's life story.

videos.title: The Queen is Wild
videos.overview: The Martian Queen kidnaps Cadet in an all-out attempt to exact revenge on Dodgers, who abandoned her at the wedding altar.

videos.title: Back to the Academy
videos.overview: Dodgers must keep his Protectorate Captain's certification by taking a yearly course. He encounters a tough space academy drill sergeant and his own disdain for authority in the process.

videos.title: Enemy Yours
videos.overview: Jealous that Marvin has another archenemy, Dodgers involves himself in Marvin's skirmish with the dreaded Dr. Woe.

videos.title: Duck Departure
videos.overview: Tired of mounting "space hijinks," Dodgers quits the Protectorate to work in the food service industry, where familiar characters somehow tend to resurface.

videos.title: Pig Planet
videos.overview: Dodgers and Cadet visit Cadet's home planet, Swinus Nine, to quell the cruel reign of his evil cousin Zag.

videos.title: Invictus Interruptus
videos.overview: Dodgers and Cadet must slow down the Invictus, an awesome new Martian space destroyer, so that Star Johnson can engage it in battle.

videos.title: Pet Peeved
videos.overview: Dodgers demands a pet and settles on a cute, fuzzy little Energy Mutator alien creature.

videos.title: The Menace of Maninsuit
videos.overview: Dodges and Cadet help a robotic child battle the normally docile Maninsuit monster.

videos.title: K-9 Quarry
videos.overview: Marvin and K-9 go on a hunting trip, then discover they've become prey.

videos.title: Talent Show a Go-Go
videos.overview: Dodgers borrows Tom Jones' voice to enter a talent contest.

videos.title: The Love of a Father
videos.overview: Dodgers becomes attached to a villain he releases from an icy prison.

videos.title: The New Cadet
videos.overview: Dodgers' new cadet harbors an obsession over him.

videos.title: The Love Duck
videos.overview: Dodgers gets blindsided by a Martian attack while carrying tourists.

videos.title: The Fudd
videos.overview: A mysterious scourge strikes members of the Protectorate. It spreads to Earth and then to Mars, leaving only Dodgers, Cadet and Marvin oddly untouched.

videos.title: The Mark of Xero
videos.overview: Dodgers has a swashbuckling adventure.

videos.title: I See Duck People
videos.overview: Dodgers, Cadet and I.Q. battle ghosts aboard a haunted spaceship.

videos.title: Deathmatch Duck
videos.overview: A living crystal planet forces Dodgers to battle Taz.

videos.title: Deconstructing Dodgers
videos.overview: I.Q. and the Martian Queen review Dodger's adventures.

videos.title: M.M.O.R.P.D.
videos.overview: Dodgers and Cadet join a band of mythical adventurers to thwart the wicked sorceress Lezah.

videos.title: Old McDodgers
videos.overview: Dodgers takes charge of running the hydroponic space farm aboard his vessel.

videos.title: Diva Delivery
videos.overview: Dodgers transports an intergalactic singing star, Lady Chanticleer, to the Fluoride Festival of Festoovius Five, taking tons of abuse from the perfectionist diva.

videos.title: Castle High
videos.overview: I.Q. Hi makes the mistake of leaving Dodgers alone with his ancestor's castle.

videos.title: Surf the Stars
videos.overview: When his status as Surf King on an all-beach planet is wiped out by the Crusher, Dodgers must prevail in an impossible surfing contest.

videos.title: Samurai Quack
videos.overview: Ingesting improperly self-prepared sushi sends Dodgers into a vivid fever dream.

videos.title: Of Course You Know This Means War and Peace (1)
videos.overview: When Dodgers brings Earth and Mars to the brink of war, Dodgers betrays Cadet by letting him take the blame for Dodgers' offense, landing the young pig in space prison.

videos.title: Of Course You Know This Means War and Peace (2)
videos.overview: The treaty signing does not go smoothly, and Dodgers finally realizes he must restore his friendship with Cadet by clearing Cadet's name.

videos.title: Till Doom Do Us Part
videos.overview: A truce between Earth and Mars leaves Dodgers bored. Meanwhile, Roboto returns with a thirst for revenge as he assembles all of Dodgers' previous villains together to form the Legion of Duck Doom.

videos.title: Villainstruck
videos.overview: Dodgers and the Cadet go up against a hypnotist named the Magnificent Rogue, who is intent on flooding the Earth. Problems arise, however, when Rogue manages to hypnotize everyone into thinking he's the greatest, including Dodgers and Cadet.

videos.title: Just the Two of Us
videos.overview: The Cadet and the Centurions go on separate vacations away from their bosses.

videos.title: The Kids Are All Wrong
videos.overview: Dodgers and Cadet go undercover in one of earth's high schools in order to stop a martian spy from sending earth's teenagers into lunatics.

videos.title: Win, Lose or Duck
videos.overview: Dodgers, Cadet, Dr. I.Q. Hi, The Martian Queen, Martian Commander X-2 and a random centurion fall for an Internet scam. A random stranger forces them to fight for their lives.

videos.title: Boar to be Riled
videos.overview: In order to get a free rocket scooter from the Protectorate, Dodgers and the Cadet must go undercover at a rocket cycle rally on Planet Dakota. However, they immediately find out that it's actually an innocent appreciation club for rocket cycles. Now, Dodgers takes it upon himself to turn these law-abiding citizens into lawless marauders.

videos.title: Clean Bill of Health
videos.overview: I.Q. Hi builds a detoxification machine and uses it on Dodgers as a test subject. The machine rids Dodgers of anything impure and turns him into the perfect duck. But Dodgers' friends and enemies quickly learn they like the old Dodgers better.

videos.title: The Best of Captains, the Worst of Captains
videos.overview: Dodgers and Star Johnson go against each other to win the "Captain of the Year" award and the heart of a female Lieutenant.

videos.title: That's Lifomatica
videos.overview: Dodgers invites people to a party to celebrate his new Lifomatica, a system designed to make life easier. That is, until Lifomatica goes insane and traps the guests inside the ship.

videos.title: Diamond Boogie
videos.overview: Dodgers and the Cadet team up with officer Paprika Solo on Groovica to discover the location of the galaxy's missing supply of diamonds.

videos.title: Corporate Pigfall
videos.overview: When the Cadet quits the Protectorate to become a big corporate CEO, Dodgers decides to get him back by sabotaging his company with the help of his new Cadet, Egghead Jr.

videos.title: The Six Wazillion Dollar Duck
videos.overview: After being injured, Dodgers receives cyborganic parts, which give him super powers. Meanwhile, the Martian Queen and X-2 kidnap other cyborg people from Earth to steal their technology, using the dubious help of Dr. Maniac.

videos.title: Too Close for Combat
videos.overview: The Martian Queen hires the highly unusual assassins Hubie and Bert, who trick Dodgers and Cadet into thinking the other is out to kill them.

videos.title: The Fins of War
videos.overview: While on a diplomatic mission to an aquatic planet, Dodgers instigates war between the dolphin and shark people. Dodgers and Cadet are drafted to fight on opposing sides, but must find a way to bring about peace.

videos.title: Good Duck Hunting
videos.overview: A criminal gambling kingpin hires a gang of bounty hunters to kill Dodgers, but his plan goes downhill when one of the bounty hunters quits and offers to help Dodgers.

videos.title: Consumption Overruled
videos.overview: When Hungortus the Eater of Worlds heads toward the solar system for his next meal, Dodgers and the Martians hire lawyers to convince him of which planet to eat: Earth or Mars.

videos.title: A Lame Duck Mind
videos.overview: A psychic supervillain named Manobrain, steals top secret codes and hides them in Dodgers' brain. I.Q. Hi, Cadet, Manobrain, and embodiments of Dodgers' personality explore his mind in their quest to find them.

videos.title: Master & Disaster
videos.overview: A lightning-fast burglar eludes the Galactic Protectorate, forcing Dodgers and Cadet to track down an imposing Kung Fu master for assistance.

videos.title: All in the Crime Family
videos.overview: When a crime family corners the galaxy's chewing gum market, Dodgers and the Cadet recruit rival gangsters to fight crime with crime.

videos.title: In Space, No One Can Hear You Rock
videos.overview: The Martians create a weapon to drain energy from Earth's music and use its atomic power to destroy the Earth. Dodgers unfreezes Megadeth star, Dave Mustaine, to play enough heavy metal to overload the device.

videos.title: Ridealong Calamity
videos.overview: I.Q. Hi joins Dodgers and the Cadet for his annual ride along misadventure. Dodgers and the Cadet gradually grow tired of I.Q. Hi tagging along and they ask the Martians to fake an attack, so I.Q. Hi can save the day and leave. Unfortunately, the Martians plan to attack for real.

videos.title: Bonafide Heroes
videos.overview: Kirk Manlord, the host of a sleazy reality show Bonafide Heroes about universe's heroes, does a piece on Duck Dodgers. The crew follows Duck 24/7 and interviews his enemies and friends. Dodgers decides to use this opportunity to promote himself.
